biotools.summary: AlphaFold2 is an AI system developed by Google DeepMind that predicts protein structures from amino acid sequences with high accuracy. It offers a web interface, API documentation, and Docker containers for users to access and utilize its capabilities in various research areas, particularly drug discovery and structural biology.
